disclaimers: Training compensation provided except during Primary Elections; rates per current county schedule
disclosure_of_risks: Election Day runs 6:00 a.m. through closing and results delivery; early voting periods vary
guarantees_or_promises: none - hourly county election-worker wage schedule
objective_evidence: County Elections Department published pay schedule

standard.s3: Hourly pay: Presiding Judge $19/hour; Presiding Alternate Judge $17/hour; Election Clerks $15/hour. Presiding Judge receives an additional $50 payment for pickup/delivery of election supplies to the Elections Office. Training compensation is provided except during Primary Elections. Student election clerks (16+) are paid hourly at the clerk rate.
standard.s4: Must be registered to vote in Hidalgo County; not hold elected office or be employed by an elected official; public-facing aptitude; student clerks 16+ with parent/guardian and principal consent and required training.
standard.s5: Official: Election Workers arrive at polling places at 6:00 a.m. and must remain until the polls are closed and results are called in or transported to Election Central; polling-place voting hours 7:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m.; Early Voting hours normally 7:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m.
standard.s6: Election Day estimated ~6:00 a.m.-~8:00 p.m. (~14 hours) including closing and results delivery.
